final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS tr ON r.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_count, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.transaction_count, CAST(p.transaction_count AS REAL) / s.total_count AS share_of_total, p.transaction_count - s.avg_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND p.transaction_count > s.avg_count
